title: Fluctuation Limits for Moderately Interacting Particle Systems
exact_target: Obtain quantitative mean-field limits strong enough to control intermediate fluctuations for the stated singular or shrinking-range interaction potentials.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005625 (OWR-14297737-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Classical and Quantum Mechanical Models of Many-Particle Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/38, pp. 2179--2246. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The report already proves a better-than-$N^{-1/2}$ smoothed error estimate conditional on an assumed mean-field convergence result. The remaining task is to verify that premise for the specified additional potentials and derive the fluctuation limit. No interchangeable interpretation of mean-square error and its square root is assumed.
